title: Pie kaimiņa (At the neighbour's)
summary: Two neighbours in a Riga apartment building meet in the stairwell and chat about everyday things.

roles.name: Kaimiņš A
roles.label: Neighbour A
roles.objective: Greet your neighbour, comment on the weather, and ask for a small favour (e.g. accepting a parcel).
starter_lines: Labrīt, kaimiņ! Kā jūs šodien jūtaties?
Vai jūs varētu pieņemt manu sūtījumu?

roles.name: Kaimiņš B
roles.label: Neighbour B
roles.objective: Reply politely, agree or politely decline the favour, and invite the neighbour for tea.
starter_lines: Protams, es pieņemšu. Vai vēlaties tēju?

objectives_shared: Comment on the weather in one short sentence.
Exchange one small favour or invitation.
Wish each other a nice day before parting.
safety_rules: No personal phone numbers or door codes.
Stay friendly and brief — A2 sentence length.
